option_b_adapter.semantics: Option B causal price semantics: decision day T uses raw close for order sizing, portfolio drift, deadbands, cash affordability, and mark-to-market. Lookback bars t < T are scaled strictly by past splits effective on or before T, preventing future corporate action leakage.

indicator_specifications.input_type: Causally split-adjusted continuous close series without future split leakage

signal_and_execution_timing.fill_pricing: Raw Open of T+1 with 5 bps slippage

primary_design.name: Fresh Portfolio Initialization
primary_design.rationale: Clean institutional out-of-sample benchmark isolating Tier 2 performance from Tier 1 terminal drift.

secondary_design.name: Continuous Carry-Forward Sensitivity
secondary_design.rationale: Tests real-world lifecycle continuity from 2019-12-31 to 2020-01-02.

execution_cost_and_dividend_model.dividend_policy: Credited in cash to balance on ex-dividend date: shares_held * divCash

primary_paired_comparison.hypothesis: Candidate A+E achieves equal or superior risk-adjusted return (Sharpe) with strictly lower maximum drawdown out-of-sample compared to E0.

statistical_analysis_method.paired_returns: Daily strategy return differences: delta_r_t = r_candidate_t - r_e0_t

acceptance_criteria.engineering_gate: 100% independent accounting ledger reconciliation (discrepancy == .000000) across all Tier 2 sessions; all 7 negative accounting controls pass; full test suite passes in clean checkout.
acceptance_criteria.scientific_gate: True empirical out-of-sample reporting without parameter tuning or post-hoc justification. Findings reported objectively regardless of whether challenger outperforms baseline.

missing_data_policy.treatment: Forward-fill last valid close for valuation; zero volume precludes execution; halts > 3 consecutive days flagged.

corporate_actions_policy.splits: Causal backward lookback scaling; cash and holdings adjust on ex-date; raw share counts scale by S, mark price scales by 1/S.
corporate_actions_policy.dividends: Credited at ex-date close based on settled shares.

forbidden_actions: Hyperparameter or model tuning based on Tier 2 performance
Transmitting credentials or publishing private API tokens
Executing live orders or remote Git push

tier3_isolation_firewall.programmatic_enforcement: Hard exception raised if query start_date or end_date >= 2022-01-01
